name: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Atlas — Canonical Work Order
purpose: Operational TODO, dependency order and project orientation. Future repository scans should read this before new work begins.

project_introduction.mission: Map Tim Dooley, the Potato of Life, Potatoism, and the wider field of people, dwellers, dogs, cult and culture, places, institutions, ideas, events, symbols and systems that become meaningful in relation to them.
project_introduction.central_difficulty: Tim Dooley and the Potato are highly relational. The project therefore maps properties, spatial structure, relationships, evidence, history and interpretation rather than isolated labels.
project_introduction.working_hypothesis: The Potato of Life is treated as a structural object whose attributed properties may be useful for comparing matter/spirit, inside/outside, root/fruit, boundary/interface, scale/dimension, geometry and transformation without assuming in advance what they prove.
project_introduction.goal: Build a navigable repository in which the highest-value information can be reached from multiple directions and every important thing has a canonical place.
project_introduction.method: Map first; connect second; test third; interpret fourth; preserve uncertainty.

core_questions: What is a potato as a physical, biological, spatial and temporal object?
What properties can it have, and what relationships follow from those properties?
What can the Potato become symbolically: chariot, angel, messenger, vessel, ladder, door, tree, seed, root, fruit, light?
How does the Potato of Life's vesica-piscis geometry work mathematically?
How do mandorla, wedge, Door, Jesus Door, Son, Father, Axis, Ladder and Tree relate?
Which properties survive scale, rotation, reflection, deformation, cutting or other transformations?
Which patterns recur across objects, organisms, people, institutions and world systems?
Which claims are observed, historical, calculated, project-defined, interpretive or hypothetical?
What becomes visible when the entire map is sufficiently connected?
core_rule: Do not expand a broken or duplicated layer. Audit, simplify, validate, then expand.

gates.name: Repository snapshot
gates.rule: Inspect tree, routes, manifests, schemas, counts and recent changes before editing.

gates.name: Bug gate
gates.rule: Broken JSON, links, JavaScript, files, references and routes outrank enrichment.

gates.name: Duplication gate
gates.rule: Every new dataset must be checked against existing canonical owners.

gates.name: Architecture gate
gates.rule: Every dataset has one owner, stable schema, purpose and consumer.

gates.name: Evidence gate
gates.rule: Empirical and historical claims require provenance; project symbolism must be labelled.

gates.name: Identity gate
gates.rule: Entities and relationships resolve to canonical IDs.

gates.name: Validation gate
gates.rule: Run structural, semantic, reference, duplicate and completeness checks.

gates.name: View gate
gates.rule: Website pages are views over canonical data.

gates.name: Release gate
gates.rule: Update manifests/counts only after underlying data and checks pass.

phases.name: Fully map the Potato and Potato of Life
Rebuild and extend the Spatial Potato
tasks: model the potato as a 3D object
map centre, axes, sections, wedges and cut faces
model Door as threshold/interface rather than only a symbol
test topological changes caused by cutting
compare physical potato geometry with Potato of Life geometry without forcing alignment
map time, motion, gravity, light, water, nutrient and information pathways
repeat the grammar across cell/tuber/plant/farm/food-system/world scales

phases.name: Simplify interface around finished data model

priority_rule: Critical gates and bugs outrank new data. Structural simplification outranks enrichment. Evidence-backed core data outranks decorative expansion. New layers require a canonical owner, evidence model, relationships and consumer.
expansion_rule: Before adding a new file, ask whether an existing canonical dataset can hold the information. If yes, extend it rather than creating another parallel dataset.
definition_of_done: A phase is done only when its data exists, consumers work, references resolve, provenance is adequate, duplicates are controlled, manifests are accurate and the integrity checker passes.
